content: The original documents are pre-processed (sentence splitting and tokenization with ScispaCy). We do not perform stop word removal or lower-casing of the tokens. The BIO labeling scheme is used to capture the order of tokens belonging to the same entity type and enable span-level detection of entities. Detection of nested and/or discontinuous entities is not supported. The annotated corpus is randomized and split in five folds using scikit-learn BIBREF9. Each fold has a train, test and dev split with the test split defined as .15% of the train split. This ensures comparability between the presented systems.
